$comment: Expected findings drafted with pnpm packs:truth (each repository's own TypeScript 5.9.3, scripts off) and its merged upgrade commit, reviewed by hand before the pack was scored. One site per change: the import line with the compiler's TS2305, and each non-consecutive JSX use the upgrade commit changed. Renames of names 1.x still exports (SFPCA: Trash2, HelpCircle, CheckCircle, XCircle, Loader2, all aliases at 1.47.0 with no deprecation) are optional and not sites. cubicsteak/keep is a negative control with no expected site. See RESEARCH.md.

repos.why: Next.js application, one package, npm. Upgrade df0669aa473bd825ca47a3e7d1e9a6df875313b2 replaces the removed Github brand icon with @tabler/icons-react's IconBrandGithub; the compiler reports the import only.

findings.note: TS2305 Github; the upgrade imports IconBrandGithub from @tabler/icons-react instead.
<Github> becomes <IconBrandGithub>; no compiler error of its own.

repos.why: Next.js application, one package, npm. Upgrade e0e06ada6ed4e4b6d501b7882d74f9622dedc678 (PR #163, "migrate lucide-react to v1") replaces Facebook, Instagram and Twitter with local Simple Icons components; the compiler reports the two imports.

Negative control: Next.js application, one package, npm, 45 files importing lucide-react and no removed icon. Upgrade cc8fb5147d1f28fc46d5a8239b1bb648975df546 (PR #40) changes only the manifest and lockfile; the repository's TypeScript reports nothing new at 1.47.0. Every site reported here is a false positive.
